beats.description: Catherine holds a glowing branding tip against the open botanical ledger, which sizzles while Juliana weeps.
Catherine taunts Juliana about her brave face and says Juliana must say goodbye to her mother as she swings the flaming iron upward.
Juliana's despair turns to cold resolve; she looks up at Catherine and defiantly orders her to burn it.
Catherine is startled by the defiance; Juliana orders the whole ledger burned and declares that her mother's teachings cannot be destroyed.
Catherine accuses Juliana of thinking herself better; Juliana calmly replies that Catherine's cruelty does that for her and says she knows what she is.
Catherine calls Juliana a disgraced woman; Juliana says she survived and speaks of Gerald leaving her and his measure of women by wealth and name.
Juliana says Gerald can have Clarissa and that he lost her; Catherine screams that she was rejected, and Juliana replies that she was freed and found a man who never asked her worth.
Catherine dismisses Juliana's soldier; Juliana names him her husband and says he showed her more love than Catherine's world did.
Catherine says Juliana knows nothing of her world; Juliana lists beauty, money, family and a perfect name, and says Catherine's world values people who never embarrass those beside them.
Juliana says Catherine has never learned to make anyone love her; Catherine snaps, raises the poker and screams for silence, and Juliana declares she is right.

Juliana mocks Catherine's need to threaten a chained woman; Catherine raises the iron, vows to see how brave Juliana is when it touches her skin, and thrusts it to a stop millimeters from Juliana's right eye as the frame cuts to black.

revelations.claim: Juliana states that Gerald left her and that this was the best thing he ever did for her; she says he wanted a wife who would bring wealth and family name, and that he lost her (Juliana's assertion, unverified on screen).
creates_questions: What exactly happened between Juliana and Gerald, and why did he leave?
Is Clarissa connected to Gerald's departure?

revelations.claim: Juliana says she has a husband whom she loves; Catherine dismisses him as a soldier and a nobody (claims only, the husband is not shown).
creates_questions: Who is Juliana's husband and what is his relationship to Catherine's world?
How will Catherine react to Juliana's remarriage?

revelations.claim: Juliana says her mother taught her herbal knowledge that cannot be destroyed, and Catherine calls this knowledge a few herbs.
creates_questions: What knowledge did Juliana's mother pass on, and how much of the ledger survives?

unresolved_questions.question: Will the branding iron touch Juliana's right eye, and does she survive the cliffhanger?
Who is Juliana's husband, and is he the soldier Catherine mocks?
How much of the botanical ledger is destroyed, and what remains of the mother's teachings?
What happened between Juliana and Gerald, and who is Clarissa?
